---- MODULE W4Od17m3p3t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Routers, Chutes, Bags, NoLeader
VARIABLES leader, assign, slow, pending

ASSUME NoLeader \notin Routers

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Routers \cup {NoLeader}
    /\ assign \subseteq [chute: Chutes, bag: Bags]
    /\ slow \subseteq Routers
    /\ pending \subseteq Bags

Init ==
    /\ leader = NoLeader
    /\ assign = {}
    /\ slow = {}
    /\ pending = Bags

Elect(r) ==
    /\ r \in Routers
    /\ r \notin slow
    /\ (leader = NoLeader \/ leader \in slow)
    /\ leader' = r
    /\ UNCHANGED <<assign, slow, pending>>

Stall(r) ==
    /\ r \in Routers
    /\ r \notin slow
    /\ slow' = slow \cup {r}
    /\ leader' = IF r = leader THEN NoLeader ELSE leader
    /\ UNCHANGED <<assign, pending>>

Resume(r) ==
    /\ r \in slow
    /\ slow' = slow \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, assign, pending>>

Place(b, c) ==
    /\ leader \in Routers
    /\ leader \notin slow
    /\ b \in pending
    /\ \A a \in assign : a.chute # c
    /\ \A a \in assign : a.bag # b
    /\ assign' = assign \cup {[chute |-> c, bag |-> b]}
    /\ pending' = pending \ {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, slow>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Routers : Elect(r)
    \/ \E r \in Routers : Stall(r)
    \/ \E r \in Routers : Resume(r)
    \/ \E b \in Bags, c \in Chutes : Place(b, c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<leader, assign, slow, pending>>

NoDoubleBooking ==
    \A a1, a2 \in assign : (a1.chute = a2.chute) => (a1.bag = a2.bag)
====
nl:
An airport baggage router coordinates a small pool of routing controllers that hand bags onto physical chutes. At any moment one controller is elected leader and is the only one permitted to place bags. Each bag starts as pending and, once placed, occupies exactly one chute. A controller may become temporarily slow (it is not failed, just unresponsive) and a slow controller cannot be leader; if the current leader becomes slow it immediately steps down, leaving the post vacant until a non-slow controller is elected to take over. Only the leader, while it is not slow, may assign a pending bag to a chute, and it will refuse to reuse a chute that is already occupied or to place a bag that has already been placed. Slow controllers can later resume and rejoin the pool. The concern is that a botched failover could let two different bags be committed to the very same chute.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no chute is ever occupied by two different bags at the same time.

---- MODULE W4Od3m8p4t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Members, Accounts, Amounts, MaxCap, NoHolder
ASSUME NoHolder \notin Members

VARIABLES coarse, fine, used, cap

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse \in Members \cup {NoHolder}
    /\ fine \in Accounts \cup {NoHolder}
    /\ used \in 0..MaxCap
    /\ cap \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ coarse = NoHolder
    /\ fine = NoHolder
    /\ used = 0
    /\ cap = MaxCap

AcquireCoarse(m) ==
    /\ coarse = NoHolder
    /\ coarse' = m
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, used, cap>>

AcquireFine(a) ==
    /\ coarse \in Members
    /\ fine = NoHolder
    /\ fine' = a
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, used, cap>>

Post(amt) ==
    /\ coarse \in Members
    /\ fine \in Accounts
    /\ amt \in Amounts
    /\ used + amt <= cap
    /\ used' = used + amt
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, cap>>

AdjustCap(c) ==
    /\ c \in 0..MaxCap
    /\ c >= used
    /\ cap' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, used>>

ReleaseAll ==
    /\ coarse \in Members
    /\ coarse' = NoHolder
    /\ fine' = NoHolder
    /\ UNCHANGED <<used, cap>>

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Members : AcquireCoarse(m)
    \/ \E a \in Accounts : AcquireFine(a)
    \/ \E amt \in Amounts : Post(amt)
    \/ \E c \in 0..MaxCap : AdjustCap(c)
    \/ ReleaseAll

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<coarse, fine, used, cap>>

WithinCapacity == used <= cap
====
nl:
A bank runs an interbank settlement batch protected by a two-level (hierarchical) lock: a coarse batch lock guarding the whole batch, and per-account fine locks nested inside it. A settling member bank must first take the coarse lock, then take a fine lock on a specific account, and only then may it post a settlement debit that consumes some of the batch's bounded liquidity capacity. A post is refused unless the remaining capacity can absorb it. An operator may adjust the batch capacity at runtime, but a reduction is only permitted down to the amount already consumed, never below it. When finished, the holder releases all its locks so another member can proceed. The invariant of concern is that concurrent posting under a shrinking capacity must never let consumed liquidity exceed the current capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the total consumed liquidity never exceeds the current batch capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od9m8p6t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Controllers, Authorized, Feeders, MaxEpoch, NoLock
ASSUME Authorized \subseteq Controllers
ASSUME NoLock \notin Controllers

VARIABLES regionLock, feederLock, epoch, inbox, executed

TypeOK ==
    /\ regionLock \in Controllers \cup {NoLock}
    /\ feederLock \in Controllers \cup {NoLock}
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ inbox \subseteq [sender: Controllers, feeder: Feeders, ep: 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ executed \subseteq [sender: Controllers, feeder: Feeders]

Init ==
    /\ regionLock = NoLock
    /\ feederLock = NoLock
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ inbox = {}
    /\ executed = {}

TakeRegion(c) ==
    /\ regionLock = NoLock
    /\ regionLock' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<feederLock, epoch, inbox, executed>>

TakeFeeder(c) ==
    /\ regionLock = c
    /\ feederLock = NoLock
    /\ feederLock' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<regionLock, epoch, inbox, executed>>

Send(c, f) ==
    /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {[sender |-> c, feeder |-> f, ep |-> epoch]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<regionLock, feederLock, epoch, executed>>

Reconfig ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ regionLock' = NoLock
    /\ feederLock' = NoLock
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inbox, executed>>

Execute(msg) ==
    /\ msg \in inbox
    /\ msg.sender \in Authorized
    /\ regionLock = msg.sender
    /\ feederLock = msg.sender
    /\ msg.ep = epoch
    /\ executed' = executed \cup {[sender |-> msg.sender, feeder |-> msg.feeder]}
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {msg}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<regionLock, feederLock, epoch>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : TakeRegion(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : TakeFeeder(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, f \in Feeders : Send(c, f)
    \/ Reconfig
    \/ \E msg \in inbox : Execute(msg)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<regionLock, feederLock, epoch, inbox, executed>>

OnlyAuthorizedShed == \A e \in executed : e.sender \in Authorized
====
nl:
A power-grid load shedder executes shed commands issued by field controllers over an unreliable channel that may deliver messages out of order. The system uses a hierarchical lock: a controller must hold the region lock and then the feeder lock before its command can take effect. Each command message carries the sender's identity and the configuration epoch it was minted under. The dispatcher accepts a pending command only when the sender is one of the officially authorized controllers, the sender currently holds both locks, and the command's epoch matches the live epoch; otherwise the message is a stale or rogue message and is dropped. A reconfiguration bumps the epoch, instantly invalidating in-flight commands minted under the old epoch. Because messages linger and reorder, the danger is that a message from an unauthorized station, or a leftover message from a superseded epoch, could still trip a breaker.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every executed shed command was issued by an officially authorized controller.

---- MODULE W4Od6m9p1t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Cars, MaxEpoch, MaxVer

VARIABLES version, record, acked, epoch, settled

TypeOK ==
    /\ version \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ record \subseteq Cars
    /\ acked \subseteq Cars
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ settled \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ version = 0
    /\ record = {}
    /\ acked = {}
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ settled = TRUE

BeginReconfig ==
    /\ settled = TRUE
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ settled' = FALSE
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, record, acked>>

EndReconfig ==
    /\ settled = FALSE
    /\ settled' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, record, acked, epoch>>

Commit(car, observed) ==
    /\ settled = TRUE
    /\ car \notin record
    /\ observed = version
    /\ version < MaxVer
    /\ record' = record \cup {car}
    /\ acked' = acked \cup {car}
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, settled>>

Reject(car, observed) ==
    /\ observed # version
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, record, acked, epoch, settled>>

Next ==
    \/ BeginReconfig
    \/ EndReconfig
    \/ \E car \in Cars, observed \in 0..MaxVer : Commit(car, observed)
    \/ \E car \in Cars, observed \in 0..MaxVer : Reject(car, observed)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<version, record, acked, epoch, settled>>

NoLostAccept == acked \subseteq record
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Cars = {carA, carB, carC}
  MaxEpoch = 2
  MaxVer = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostAccept
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper keeps a shared dispatch record listing which hall calls have been accepted. Cars submit accept-requests over a channel that reorders messages, so requests may arrive in any order. To avoid lost updates, each accepted request is committed using a compare-and-swap on a version number: a car reads the current version, and its commit succeeds only if the version it observed still matches the live version, at which point the request is appended to the record and the version advances. A car whose observed version is stale (another commit landed first) is rejected and must retry. Periodically the controller performs an epoch-numbered reconfiguration that increments a config epoch; commits are only accepted while the config is settled. The worry is that a reordered or stale commit could overwrite the record and silently drop an already-accepted call.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every car whose commit was acknowledged appears in the shared dispatch record.

---- MODULE W4Od19m7p0t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Patrons, Copies, Free

ASSUME Free \notin Patrons

VARIABLES owner, claims, inCirc, requests

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Copies -> Patrons \cup {Free}]
    /\ claims \in [Copies -> SUBSET Patrons]
    /\ inCirc \subseteq Copies
    /\ requests \subseteq [patron: Patrons, copy: Copies]

Init ==
    /\ owner = [c \in Copies |-> Free]
    /\ claims = [c \in Copies |-> {}]
    /\ inCirc = Copies
    /\ requests = {}

Request(p, c) ==
    /\ requests' = requests \cup {[patron |-> p, copy |-> c]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, claims, inCirc>>

Acquire(req) ==
    /\ req \in requests
    /\ req.copy \in inCirc
    /\ owner[req.copy] = Free
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![req.copy] = req.patron]
    /\ claims' = [claims EXCEPT ![req.copy] = claims[req.copy] \cup {req.patron}]
    /\ requests' = requests \ {req}
    /\ UNCHANGED inCirc

Release(c) ==
    /\ owner[c] \in Patrons
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![c] = Free]
    /\ claims' = [claims EXCEPT ![c] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inCirc, requests>>

Withdraw(c) ==
    /\ c \in inCirc
    /\ owner[c] = Free
    /\ inCirc' = inCirc \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, claims, requests>>

Reinstate(c) ==
    /\ c \notin inCirc
    /\ inCirc' = inCirc \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, claims, requests>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Patrons, c \in Copies : Request(p, c)
    \/ \E req \in requests : Acquire(req)
    \/ \E c \in Copies : Release(c)
    \/ \E c \in Copies : Withdraw(c)
    \/ \E c \in Copies : Reinstate(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<owner, claims, inCirc, requests>>

ExclusiveHold ==
    \A c \in Copies :
        /\ claims[c] \subseteq (IF owner[c] \in Patrons THEN {owner[c]} ELSE {})
====

CONSTANTS
  Patrons = {pA, pB}
  Copies = {cp1, cp2}
  Free = Free
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ExclusiveHold
nl:
A library book reservation system guards each copy of a title as a critical resource that at most one patron may hold at a time. Holding is arbitrated by a compare-and-swap register per copy: the register is either free or names its current holder. A patron acquires a copy only by swapping the register from free to itself, and releases it by swapping back to free. The number of lendable copies of the title can change at runtime as copies are added to or withdrawn from circulation, but a copy may only be withdrawn while it is free, never while a patron holds it. A patron never acquires a copy that is not currently in circulation. The core guarantee is mutual exclusion: no single copy is ever simultaneously held by two different patrons.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no copy of the title is held by two different patrons at the same time.

---- MODULE W4Od0m6p0t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Teams, Rooms, MaxTime, Duration, Free
ASSUME Free \notin Teams

VARIABLES leaseOwner, leaseExp, occ, clock, crashed

TypeOK ==
    /\ leaseOwner \in [Rooms -> Teams \cup {Free}]
    /\ leaseExp \in [Rooms -> 0..MaxTime]
    /\ occ \in [Rooms -> SUBSET Teams]
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxTime
    /\ crashed \subseteq Teams

Init ==
    /\ leaseOwner = [r \in Rooms |-> Free]
    /\ leaseExp = [r \in Rooms |-> 0]
    /\ occ = [r \in Rooms |-> {}]
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ crashed = {}

Acquire(t, r) ==
    /\ (leaseOwner[r] = Free \/ clock >= leaseExp[r])
    /\ leaseOwner' = [leaseOwner EXCEPT ![r] = t]
    /\ leaseExp' = [leaseExp EXCEPT ![r] = IF clock + Duration <= MaxTime THEN clock + Duration ELSE MaxTime]
    /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![r] = {t}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, crashed>>

Renew(t, r) ==
    /\ leaseOwner[r] = t
    /\ t \notin crashed
    /\ leaseExp' = [leaseExp EXCEPT ![r] = IF clock + Duration <= MaxTime THEN clock + Duration ELSE MaxTime]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseOwner, occ, clock, crashed>>

Release(t, r) ==
    /\ leaseOwner[r] = t
    /\ leaseOwner' = [leaseOwner EXCEPT ![r] = Free]
    /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![r] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseExp, clock, crashed>>

Crash(t) ==
    /\ t \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseOwner, leaseExp, occ, clock>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxTime
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseOwner, leaseExp, occ, crashed>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Teams, r \in Rooms : Acquire(t, r)
    \/ \E t \in Teams, r \in Rooms : Renew(t, r)
    \/ \E t \in Teams, r \in Rooms : Release(t, r)
    \/ \E t \in Teams : Crash(t)
    \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<leaseOwner, leaseExp, occ, clock, crashed>>

OneTeamPerRoom ==
    \A r \in Rooms : occ[r] \subseteq (IF leaseOwner[r] = Free THEN {} ELSE {leaseOwner[r]})
====

CONSTANTS
  Teams = {tA, tB}
  Rooms = {or1, or2}
  MaxTime = 3
  Duration = 2
  Free = Free
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OneTeamPerRoom
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler grants each operating room to at most one surgical team at a time using a lease with an expiry deadline. A team acquires a room only when the room's lease is free or has already expired according to a shared clock; acquiring installs the team as the room's occupant and stamps a fresh expiry. The holding team may renew its lease to push the expiry further out, but only while it has not crashed. A team can crash silently: it simply stops renewing and never explicitly releases, so the scheduler must rely on lease expiry to reclaim the room for someone else. A team may also release a room it holds. Time advances by ticks. The safety concern is that lease reclamation after a silent crash must never place two different teams into the same operating room simultaneously.
SAFETY PROPERTY: each operating room is occupied by at most one surgical team at any instant.

---- MODULE W4Od11m2p5t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences
CONSTANTS Jobs, Stations

VARIABLES yesVotes, decision, printLog, blocked

TypeOK ==
    /\ yesVotes \subseteq [job: Jobs, station: Stations]
    /\ decision \in [Jobs -> {"none", "commit", "abort"}]
    /\ printLog \in Seq(Jobs)
    /\ blocked \subseteq Jobs

Printed == { printLog[i] : i \in DOMAIN printLog }

Init ==
    /\ yesVotes = {}
    /\ decision = [j \in Jobs |-> "none"]
    /\ printLog = << >>
    /\ blocked = {}

Vote(j, s) ==
    /\ decision[j] = "none"
    /\ yesVotes' = yesVotes \cup {[job |-> j, station |-> s]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<decision, printLog, blocked>>

Decide(j) ==
    /\ decision[j] = "none"
    /\ j \notin blocked
    /\ \A s \in Stations : [job |-> j, station |-> s] \in yesVotes
    /\ decision' = [decision EXCEPT ![j] = "commit"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<yesVotes, printLog, blocked>>

AdminForceAbort(j) ==
    /\ decision[j] # "commit"
    /\ j \notin Printed
    /\ decision' = [decision EXCEPT ![j] = "abort"]
    /\ blocked' = blocked \cup {j}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<yesVotes, printLog>>

Print(j) ==
    /\ decision[j] = "commit"
    /\ j \notin Printed
    /\ printLog' = Append(printLog, j)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<yesVotes, decision, blocked>>

Idle == UNCHANGED <<yesVotes, decision, printLog, blocked>>

Next ==
    \/ \E j \in Jobs, s \in Stations : Vote(j, s)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : Decide(j)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : AdminForceAbort(j)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : Print(j)
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<yesVotes, decision, printLog, blocked>>

PrintedAtMostOnce ==
    \A i, k \in DOMAIN printLog : printLog[i] = printLog[k] => i = k
====
nl:
A print shop job spooler commits each print job through a two-phase commit across the participating press stations. In the voting phase every station casts a yes vote for a job; the coordinator decides commit for a job only once all stations have voted yes, and decides abort otherwise. Printing a job is an irreversible physical action: paper and toner are consumed and cannot be un-printed. A job may be printed only after it has been decided commit, and only if it has not already been printed. A privileged shop administrator may override the protocol by force-aborting a job before it prints, which blocks it. The system records the actual sequence of print actions. The overriding safety concern is that no job is ever physically printed more than once, regardless of retries, reordering of votes, or administrator intervention.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no print job is physically printed more than once.

---- MODULE W4Od15m5p6t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Members, Authorized, Prices, Quorum, MaxRound, NoPrice
ASSUME Authorized \subseteq Members
ASSUME NoPrice \notin Prices

VARIABLES round, yesVotes, openPrice, backers

TypeOK ==
    /\ round \in 0..MaxRound
    /\ yesVotes \subseteq Members
    /\ openPrice \in Prices \cup {NoPrice}
    /\ backers \subseteq Members

Init ==
    /\ round = 0
    /\ yesVotes = {}
    /\ openPrice = NoPrice
    /\ backers = {}

CastVote(m) ==
    /\ openPrice = NoPrice
    /\ m \notin yesVotes
    /\ yesVotes' = yesVotes \cup {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<round, openPrice, backers>>

Withdraw(m) ==
    /\ m \in yesVotes
    /\ yesVotes' = yesVotes \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<round, openPrice, backers>>

Open(p) ==
    /\ openPrice = NoPrice
    /\ Cardinality(yesVotes \cap Authorized) >= Quorum
    /\ openPrice' = p
    /\ backers' = yesVotes \cap Authorized
    /\ UNCHANGED <<round, yesVotes>>

AdminNewRound ==
    /\ openPrice = NoPrice
    /\ round < MaxRound
    /\ round' = round + 1
    /\ yesVotes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<openPrice, backers>>

Idle == UNCHANGED <<round, yesVotes, openPrice, backers>>

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Members : CastVote(m)
    \/ \E m \in Members : Withdraw(m)
    \/ \E p \in Prices : Open(p)
    \/ AdminNewRound
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<round, yesVotes, openPrice, backers>>

OpenedOnAuthorizedQuorum ==
    openPrice # NoPrice =>
        /\ backers \subseteq Authorized
        /\ Cardinality(backers) >= Quorum
====
nl:
A stock exchange opening auction fixes a single opening price by quorum vote of its market-maker members. Voting happens in rounds. In the current round a member may cast a yes vote for opening, or withdraw its vote. The auction opens at a price only when a quorum of officially authorized members have a live yes vote in the current round; opening records exactly which members backed it. Only authorized members' votes count toward the quorum, so a rogue unauthorized station cannot help open the market. A privileged exchange administrator may override by declaring a new round, which invalidates every vote cast in the prior round; any leftover stale votes from the old round therefore cannot contribute to opening. The auction opens at most once. The safety concern is that the market must never open except on the backing of a genuine quorum of authorized members.
SAFETY PROPERTY: if the auction has opened, it was backed by a quorum of officially authorized members.

CONSTANTS Cars, Floors, MaxEpoch

VARIABLES record, ackd, epoch, crashed, pending

    /\ record \in [Floors -> SUBSET Cars]
    /\ ackd \subseteq [car: Cars, floor: Floors]
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ crashed \subseteq Cars
    /\ pending \subseteq [car: Cars, floor: Floors, ep: 0..MaxEpoch]

Init ==
    /\ record = [f \in Floors |-> {}]
    /\ ackd = {}
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ pending = {}

Propose(car, floor) ==
    /\ car \notin crashed
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {[car |-> car, floor |-> floor, ep |-> epoch]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, ackd, epoch, crashed>>

Reconfig ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, ackd, crashed, pending>>

Apply(p) ==
    /\ p \in pending
    /\ p.ep = epoch
    /\ record' = [record EXCEPT ![p.floor] = record[p.floor] \cup {p.car}]
    /\ ackd' = ackd \cup {[car |-> p.car, floor |-> p.floor]}
    /\ pending' = pending \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, crashed>>

Crash(car) ==
    /\ car \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {car}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, ackd, epoch, pending>>

Idle == UNCHANGED <<record, ackd, epoch, crashed, pending>>

Next ==
    \/ \E car \in Cars, floor \in Floors : Propose(car, floor)
    \/ Reconfig
    \/ \E p \in pending : Apply(p)
    \/ \E car \in Cars : Crash(car)
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<record, ackd, epoch, crashed, pending>>

NoLostCredit == \A a \in ackd : a.car \in record[a.floor]
====

  Cars = {carA, carB}
  Floors = {fl1}
  MaxEpoch = 1
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostCredit
nl:
An elevator bank maintains a shared service record noting, for each floor, the set of cars that have been credited with servicing a hall call there. Cars propose service credits tagged with the current configuration epoch. A configuration change bumps the epoch to reflect a new dispatch plan; a proposal minted under an old epoch is stale and can never be applied, so it cannot corrupt the record. Applying a proposal whose epoch is live credits the proposing car into that floor's record and acknowledges the car. A car may crash silently at any time: it simply stops proposing, but any credit it already had acknowledged must remain in the shared record and must not be lost because of its disappearance. The safety concern is that no acknowledged service credit is ever dropped from the shared record.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every acknowledged service credit is still present in the shared record.

CONSTANTS Doors, Devices, Quorum

VARIABLES approvals, fires

TypeOK ==
    /\ approvals \subseteq [door: Doors, device: Devices]
    /\ fires \in [Doors -> Nat]

ApprovalsFor(d) == { a.device : a \in { x \in approvals : x.door = d } }

    /\ fires = [d \in Doors |-> 0]

    /\ approvals' = approvals \cup {[door |-> d, device |-> dev]}
    /\ UNCHANGED fires

    /\ Cardinality(ApprovalsFor(d)) >= Quorum
    /\ fires' = [fires EXCEPT ![d] = fires[d] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED approvals

    /\ [door |-> d, device |-> dev] \in approvals
    /\ fires[d] = 0
    /\ approvals' = approvals \ {[door |-> d, device |-> dev]}
    /\ UNCHANGED fires

Idle == UNCHANGED <<approvals, fires>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Doors, dev \in Devices : Broadcast(d, dev)
    \/ \E d \in Doors : Unlock(d)
    \/ \E d \in Doors, dev \in Devices : Retract(d, dev)
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<approvals, fires>>
